name: SimpleFIN

tiers.how: Sage reads bank transactions and balances via the SimpleFIN Bridge API using `assistant/scripts/money/simplefin.py`. The owner must create a SimpleFIN Bridge account at bridge.simplefin.org, connect their financial institutions through the Bridge web UI, and store the access URL in the OS credential store via setup_creds. No re-authentication is needed once linked. This path is strictly read-only.
writes: nothing; SimpleFIN is read-only in this integration

gotchas: SimpleFIN uses a simpler authentication model than Plaid but covers fewer financial institutions; verify that the owner's bank is supported before setting it up.
Transaction data may lag 1-2 days depending on the institution's feed refresh schedule.
Sage never initiates transfers, payments, or any write operation to a financial institution through SimpleFIN.
SimpleFIN Bridge is an independent service; verify its current institution coverage and pricing before recommending it.
notes: SimpleFIN is a lightweight read-only bank feed alternative to Plaid; simpler to set up but with narrower institution coverage.
